items.title: Tony Marino interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 25, 2025
items.q: I started with string bass ‘cause of my sister’s love for a Stan Getz record which had Astrud Gilberto on it, “The Girl from Ipanema.”

ctx.x: You started as a guitar player, right?

I started playing as a guitar player because of my dad, yeah. I wanted to be a drummer but I lived in a second story apartment and that wasn’t going to happen. As a matter of fact when I got a set of drums I put them in the basement and there was a gigantic fight so I had to get rid of them. And I tried rock bands in the cellar and everything and it didn’t work out with my family so I had to get them out of there and find another place for them. But, so yeah I played a little guitar, I took some lessons, and in…
How do you memorize tunes? Because I saw a video of you with Dave Liebman and you’re playing “Lush Life” in the famous jazz club there in Delaware Water Gap.
